entries.title: Genesis 5:1
segments: Book of the generations; history of Adam and his posterity.

entries.title: Genesis 5:2
segments: Their name Adam; that is, man.

entries.title: Genesis 5:3
segments: In his own likeness; a human being, and depraved; who, without the renewing grace of God, would never be holy, but would live and die in sin.

entries.title: Genesis 5:24
segments: Walked with God; was cordially reconciled to him,

; sought his guidance, believed his declarations, obeyed his commands, and enjoyed his presence. 
 
  Was not; was not found on the earth; nor did he die, but God took him to heaven.

. 
 
To walk with God is the highest duty, the greatest honor, excellence, and blessedness of man.

entries.title: Genesis 5:27
segments: He died; in the year after the flood.

entries.title: Genesis 5:29
segments:
Noah; signifying rest; expressive of the hope and expectation that he would be a great blessing. 
 
Parents often hope for great comfort from their children; and if children are pious, especially if they become preachers of righteousness, and are instrumental in the salvation of men, parents have reason to rejoice with great joy.

entries.title: Genesis 5:31
segments: He died; five years before the flood.

entries.title: Genesis 5:32
segments: Japheth;  he is generally thought to have been the elder; see note to
; but Shem is mentioned first, because from him would descend the Messiah.
